name: Rio de Janeiro: Carioca Landscapes between the Mountain and the Sea
description: Rio de Janeiro's World Heritage area stretches from the forested peaks of Tijuca National Park down to the beaches of Guanabara Bay. It takes in the Christ the Redeemer statue on Corcovado, the Botanical Gardens founded in 1808, and the landscaped waterfront of Copacabana. Much of the park's forest was replanted in the 1800s after coffee farming threatened the city's water, and monkeys and coatis now live there.
